description: Prepares a custom, from-scratch, AI-designed WeInc website. It does NOT make a site: it returns a link, and the AI build starts only after the person confirms in their browser. To make a finished site from a ready-made design straight away, create_website_from_template is the tool. Put everything you know into `brief`: business name, what they do, location, services, audience, tone, pages wanted, contact details. Optionally pass `template_id` from find_templates. The build starts only after the person confirms on that page.

brief.description: Full description of the business and the website wanted.

name: start_website
title: Start a new website
